status: proposed; no 4b4 Hub or 4b4factory consumer exists yet
name: 4b4buk
description: Football match discovery and pre-match analysis.
entry_url_note: Set when the owner chooses the domain, e.g. https://buk.<brand-domain>/
open_mode_note: Open in the same or a new window, never in a cross-site iframe (third-party cookie and storage partitioning).

identity.note: Until a shared 4b4apps identity provider exists, 4b4buk keeps user data keyed by issuer and subject so it can join the shared account later.
